picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5B X-Labs initiative adding a dedicated AI for Physical Systems funding call signals a major federal bet on AI research at national scale, with ripple effects across the entire university research funding landscape.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: A $26.5M ARPA-H award for an AI 'co-pilot' that could bring specialist-level guidance to rural medical care is a concrete example of AI funding translating into real-world healthcare access impact.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: A $15M gift from the OpenAI Foundation to build open-source pharmacokinetic data infrastructure marks a notable industry-academia collaboration aimed at accelerating AI-driven drug development for the whole field, not just one lab.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: NSF's ELEGANT program directs federal investment toward next-generation semiconductor manufacturing specifically to support AI and high-performance computing, addressing a critical hardware bottleneck for the field.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: A new protein language model unifying sequence and 3D structure data represents a genuine scientific advance in mapping evolutionary relationships, building on the AlphaFold-era push to decode the 'protein universe.'
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's work on hardware where nanowire networks themselves act as the neural network points toward energy-efficient 'physical AI' that could fundamentally change how AI systems are built and deployed at the edge.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: Integrating EPFL/ETH Zurich's open-source Apertus model into Proton's privacy-focused Lumo assistant exposes an academically-developed LLM to tens of millions of users, a rare case of university AI research reaching mass-market deployment.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's AWS-powered Innovation Hub is a substantial academic-industry-clinical partnership aimed at embedding AI directly into medical education and care delivery.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded project using AI to reason over decades of nuclear waste safety data shows AI being applied to a high-stakes regulatory and environmental policy domain with long-term national implications.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's $3.5M prize competition for autonomous trauma surgical robotics pushes AI toward life-critical battlefield and emergency medicine applications, backed by a federal agency with a track record of fielding real technology.
picks.title: $3.5M to advance autonomous trauma robotics
